origin: KiCad schematics by the maintainer, exported for ngspice, and variants made for M16, each changing one form
author: xdylanm

test_kicad_tline.cir.note: KiCad's TLINE, which KiCad exports as an O line with an LTRA model (KiCad, by the maintainer).

test_tline_o_flags.cir.note: O with an LTRA model that writes two flags (variant).

test_tline_p2.cir.note: P with two coupled lines and their matrices, with blanks, commas and a brace (variant).

test_tline_t_ic.cir.note: T with IC=, four comma-separated values (variant).

test_tline_t_td.cir.note: T with TD= in place of KiCad's O line (variant).

test_tline_t_zo.cir.note: T with the reference's spelling Zo= (variant; decision 0019 item 3).

test_tline_u.cir.note: U as a URC line, with l= (variant).
